intelligence.title: Intelligence layers
intelligence.description: NLU first. Decision executes an inferred action with calibrated joint confidence of at least 80%, margin at least 0.08 and an unambiguous target, including mistranscribed verbs. Without valid calibration, similarity is not certainty. Negation, explicit conflicts and permissions remain enforced. LLM only runs when needed and retains confirmation for uncertain hypotheses. Start model processes separately in the app; changes apply to new requests.
